method: Primary documentation opened and relevant passages read through web tool. These support semantic review, not distributed fault experiments.

sources.supports: Last-Event-ID reports parser transport state on reconnect; application durable acknowledgement is a separate contract.
HTTP early data can be replayed; 425 response and intermediary provenance require explicit handling.
Repeatable Read retains first-statement snapshot; serialization errors require retrying the entire transaction.
PREPARE stores transaction state durably; prepared transaction remains until explicitly committed or rolled back; locks remain.
Kafka exactly-once processing for external output requires cooperation with destination; position and durable effect must be coordinated.
preStop consumes termination grace time; endpoint propagation is concurrent with local shutdown, not a guaranteed removal barrier.
Connection identity and CID differ; migration across local addresses must not reuse CID; NAT rebinding has a qualified exception.
Ordinary rowid-table composite PRIMARY KEY does not imply NOT NULL; NULL values are distinct for uniqueness. Explicit NOT NULL guards dedupe identity.
